points.description: States that sizeof returns the size (amount of memory/storage) of its operand, i.e. of a variable, expression or data type. Accept equivalent wording such as 'how much memory the object/type occupies'.

levels.says: Says it returns a size/memory-related value but is vague or incomplete (e.g. 'the size' with no mention of memory or of the operand being a variable/type).

points.description: States that the size is measured in bytes (units of char). Accept 'number of bytes'. Wrong units (bits, elements, array length) earn no marks.

rubric.notes: Full marks: sizeof gives the size of its operand (variable, expression or type) in bytes. Award 3 for the size idea and 2 for bytes; a student who says 'size in bytes' earns all 5. Wrong claims (returns value, length of array in elements, size in bits) earn no marks for that point.
